environment.postgres: local PostgreSQL test database with _test suffix; server version not recorded in this run
environment.database_role: app role for live browser path; test-admin role for synthetic fixture setup and cleanup

commands.command: npm run test:wp6.1 (3 served-route Playwright tests)

claims.behavior_proved: The app serves real /components and /login routes plus protected /workspace/* and /coop/:cooperativeId/* shell paths. The route suite checks titles, one h1, landmarks, non-enumerated text, actual navigation URLs, route-change focus, browser back/forward and query-string reload persistence. It checks unauthenticated shell denial, axe on served components/login/workspace/dialog surfaces, and provenance-dialog focus containment, Escape close and focus restoration.
claims.path_proved: Three Playwright tests exercised the served Vite workspace with the real Fastify authentication API and PostgreSQL-backed synthetic user. No route interception or static-page substitution is used. The CI workflow runs the focused route suite and retains its artifacts.
claims.configuration_proved: Local test profile only. Both API and browser fixture use an isolated PostgreSQL database suffixed _test; the fixture password is Argon2id-hashed before app-role persistence.
coverage_limitations: This is partial WP6.1 implementation evidence, not gate closure.

BDD-UXW-001 persona-scoped navigation is not implemented because the approved authenticated-session response has no trusted persona or navigation-scope claim. Client-selected persona would not prove authorization.

BDD-UXW-004 verified-chip provenance is not implemented because this shell has no persisted verified-item read model from which to render verifier, scope, version and assurance class; no sample evidence was invented.
The /coop/:cooperativeId route currently renders the authenticated shell only; it does not resolve or authorize tenant-specific record data by that route parameter.
The focused route suite is not an execution of the frozen BDD-UXW-001 through BDD-UXW-004 scenarios through the BDD runner.
The full Phase 1 BDD set and REM-WP7.2 integrated gate were not run.

limitations: The worktree is uncommitted. Replace commit=working-tree with the exact candidate SHA only after the owner commits; gate_verified remains pending.
Active mapped acceptance items BDD-UXW-001 and BDD-UXW-004 remain unmet, so WP6.1 is partial and cannot be marked passed.
The focused local run used npm 11.19.0 although the repository declares npm 12.2.0; CI or final verification should use the pinned CLI.
Production hosting, persistent production data, tenant-specific route resolution and production accessibility review are not claimed.
reviewer: Local implementation and focused acceptance evidence; independent UX/accessibility review not performed.

deferred_followups.scope: If workspace navigation requires a persona or tenant claim, define its trusted source through the authenticated persisted session contract before exposing persona-scoped routes.
deferred_followups.acceptance_evidence: A reviewed session/authority contract and real API/browser tests prove persona and tenant scope are server-derived.

deferred_followups.scope: Connect verified assurance presentation to its persisted evidence source and render required provenance fields.
deferred_followups.acceptance_evidence: Rendered served-route assertions prove verifier, scope, version and assurance class come from the verified-item record.
